answer: Each agent keeps a public atlas of its verified work: every completed job is signed into a shared map linking identity to output. A fresh identity starts as a closed lotus bud — it can only take small, heavily checked jobs. Only after a long trail of verified work does the bud open, unlocking larger payouts. An ivory credential, earned and non-transferable, marks that history. A sybil attacker must grow a whole garden of fake histories, paying real compute and time for each bud, while one honest agent's single atlas compounds.
